captions.detailed: A basket-style air fryer with a rounded rectangular main housing in matte black. On the lower front, there is a pullout drawer with a handle containing a small red safety release button. The overall design is minimalist and compact, suitable for a kitchen countertop.
captions.instruction: Generate a basket-style air fryer with a rounded main housing and a pullout drawer. The drawer should feature a handle with a small red safety release button, and the entire unit should have a sleek, matte black finish.
captions.factory: The main housing is constructed by creating a box and applying fillets to its vertical edges. The drawer is constructed as a separate part that fits into a hollowed-out lower section of the main body, using boolean subtraction. The handle is modeled using a series of extrusions and is attached to the front of the drawer, with a smaller red-colored box embedded to serve as the safety release button.
